1850 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
09-02-1850 is February 9, 1850.  
Subtract 194 days:  
Back to Jan 1, 1850: from Feb 9 → 31 days in Jan already passed, so Feb 9 is day 40 of the year (31 + 9).  
40 − 194 = −154 days from start of 1850.  
Go back into 1849: 1849 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4). Days in 1849 = 365.  
365 − 154 = 211 days left in 1849 after going back from Jan 1, 1850.  
Day 211 of 1849: July has 31 days, August has 31 days.  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30 = 31+28+31+30+31+30 = 181 days.  
211 − 181 = 30 days into July → July 30, 1849.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1849-07-30
